title: trond events output
description: JSONL stream emitted by `trond events --output json`. Each line is one audit-log entry.

command.description: The trond subcommand that was invoked.

target.description: Target type that processed the command (local | ssh).

detail.description: What the command acted on, for verbs where the verb alone does not say (exec's program, files put's destination, a recipe's source). An identifier, never a payload.

run_id.description: Correlation id shared by every entry from one recipe run, including the steps it re-execs.
